definitions.explanation: Describes movement, progress, or action that is slow and lacking speed or urgency. Can be neutral (gradual change) or negative (sluggish response).

examples.japanese: {緩慢|かんまん}な⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧
⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緩慢|かんまん}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{確実|かくじつ}→確実：02538_kakujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Recovery is slow but steadily progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緩慢|かんまん}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The slowness of the response exacerbated the damage.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {緩慢|かんまん}な⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧.

NOUN FORM: {緩慢|かんまん}さ (slowness, sluggishness)

NUANCE: {緩慢|かんまん} can be neutral (describing gradual, unhurried change) or negative (criticizing slow, inadequate response). Context determines the connotation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緩慢|かんまん}な⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧/⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧ (slow movement/progress)
- {緩慢|かんまん}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (slow response)
- {緩慢|かんまん}な⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧ (gradual change)
- {緩慢|かんまん}さ (sluggishness)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{鈍重|どんじゅう}→鈍重：09192_donjuu⟧ (dull, ponderous - more negative)
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧ (slowly - more neutral/casual)
- ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (slow, late - more common)
- ⟦{迅速|じんそく}→迅速：14294_jinsoku⟧ (swift, prompt - opposite)
